1506.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These gloves boost the power of the holder's punching moves and prevents contact when attacking foes.

1507.name: Pure Amulet (DEF)
1507.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It prevents the holder from having its stat stages lowered. It doesn't prevent stat clearing effects like Clear Smog or Haze.

1508.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This protective garment guards the holder from the additional effects of other Pokémon's damaging moves.

1509.name: Loaded Dice (ATK)

1510.name: Safety Goggles (DEF)
1510.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These protective goggles guard against powder moves, spore moves, and Sandstorm damage.

1511.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit by a super-effective move, Attack and Sp. Attack will sharply increase.

Consumed upon use.

1512.name: Blunder Policy (ATK)
1512.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder misses with an attack due to its Accuracy, Speed will sharply increase.

It doesn't activate if missing with an OHKO move or if the target is semi-invulnerable.

Consumed upon use.

1513.name: Mirror Herb (ATK)
1513.description:

1514.name: Throat Spray (ATK)
1514.description:

1515.name: Ability Shield (DEF)
1515.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It prevents the holder from having its ability suppressed or changed by any effect. It also protects against effects which bypass abilities, like Mold Breaker.

1516.name: Protective Pads (DEF)
1516.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. They prevent effects which trigger on contact when the holder attacks a foe.

1517.name: Room Service (SPEED-)

This item is consumed upon use.

1518.name: Eject Pack (DEF)

Consumed upon use.

1519.name: Utility Umbrella (DEF)
1519.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When held, it prevents the effects of rain and harsh sunlight. It doesn't prevent other weather from affecting the holder.

1520.name: Snowball (ATK)

1521.name: Luminous Moss (DEF)

1600.name: TM - Focus Punch
1600.description:
The user focuses its mind before
launching a punch. It will fail if the user
is hit before it is used.

1601.name: TM - Water Pulse
1601.description:
The user attacks the target with
a pulsing blast of water.
It may also confuse the target.

1602.name: TM - Bullet Seed
1602.description:
The user forcefully shoots seeds at the
target. Two to five seeds are shot in
rapid succession.

1603.name: TM - Giga Drain
1603.description:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage
taken by the target.

1604.name: TM - Iron Tail
1604.description:
The target is slammed with a steel-hard
tail. It may also lower the target's
Defense stat.

1605.name: TM - Shock Wave
1605.description:
The user strikes the target with a quick
jolt of electricity.
This attack cannot be evaded.

1606.name: TM - Secret Power
1606.description:
The user attacks the target with a
secret power. Its added effects vary
depending on the user's environment.

1607.name: TM - Steel Wing
1607.description:
The target is hit with wings of steel.
It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

1608.name: TM - Skill Swap
1608.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
exchange Abilities with the target.

1609.name: TM - Snatch
1609.description:
The user steals the effects of any
healing or stat-changing move the
opponent attempts to use.

1610.name: TM - Roost
1610.description:
The user lands and rests its body.
It restores the user's HP by up to
half of its max HP.

1611.name: TM - Brine
1611.description:
If the target's HP is down to about half,
this attack will hit with double
the power.

1612.name: TM - Endure
1612.description:
The user endures any attack with at least
1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is
used in succession.

1613.name: TM - Dragon Pulse
1613.description:
The target is attacked with a shock wave
generated by the user's gaping mouth.

1614.name: TM - Drain Punch
1614.description:
An energy-draining punch. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

1615.name: TM - Silver Wind
1615.description:
The target is attacked with powdery
scales blown by wind.
It may also raise all the user's stats.

1616.name: TM - Recycle
1616.description:
The user recycles a held item that
has been used in battle so it can be
used again.

1617.name: TM - Avalanche
1617.description:
An attack move that inflicts double the
damage if the user has been hurt by the
target in the same turn.

1618.name: TM - Stealth Rock
1618.description:
The user lays a trap of levitating stones
around the opponent's team. The trap
hurts opponents that switch into battle.

1619.name: TM - Captivate
1619.description:
If it is the opposite gender of the user,
the target is charmed into harshly
lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

1620.name: TM - Dark Pulse
1620.description:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued
with dark thoughts.
It may also make the target flinch.

1621.name: TM - Sleep Talk
1621.description:
While it is asleep, the user randomly uses
one of the moves it knows.

1622.name: TM - Natural Gift
1622.description:
The user draws power to attack by using
its held Berry.
The Berry determines its type and power.

1623.name: TM - Leech Life
1623.description:
The user drains the target's blood.
The user's HP is restored by half the
damage taken by the target.

1624.name: TM - Nature Power
1624.description:
An attack that makes use of nature's
power. Its effects vary depending on the
user's environment.

1625.name: TM - Air Slash
1625.description:
The user attacks with a blade of air that
slices even the sky. It may also make the
target flinch.

1626.name: TM - Bug Buzz
1626.description:
The user vibrates its wings to generate a
damaging sound wave. It may also lower
the target's Sp. Def stat.

1627.name: TM - Power Gem
1627.description:
The user attacks with a ray of light that
sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

1628.name: TM - Razor Wind
1628.description:
A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit
opposing Pokémon on the second turn.
Critical hits land more easily.

1629.name: TM - Brave Bird
1629.description:
The user tucks in its wings and charges
from a low altitude.
The user also takes serious damage.

1630.name: TM - Whirlwind
1630.description:
The target is blown away, to be replaced
by another Pokémon in its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

1631.name: TM - Nasty Plot
1631.description:
The user stimulates its brain by thinking
bad thoughts.
It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

1632.name: TM - Thunder Fang
1632.description:
The user bites with electrified fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or
leave it with paralysis.

1633.name: TM - Ice Fang
1633.description:
The user bites with cold-infused fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or
leave it frozen.

1634.name: TM - Fire Fang
1634.description:
The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or leave
it burned.

1635.name: TM - Psycho Cut
1635.description:
The user tears at the target with blades
formed by psychic power.
Critical hits land more easily.

1636.name: TM - Horn Drill
1636.description:
The user stabs the target with a horn
that rotates like a drill.
If it hits, the target faints instantly.

1637.name: TM - Take Down
1637.description:
A reckless, full-body charge attack for
slamming into the target.
It also damages the user a little.

1638.name: TM - Leaf Storm
1638.description:
The user whips up a storm of leaves around
the target. The attack's recoil harshly
reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

1639.name: TM - Power Whip
1639.description:
The user violently whirls its vines or
tentacles to harshly lash the target.

1640.name: TM - Pin Missile
1640.description:
Sharp spikes are shot at the target
in rapid succession.
They hit two to five times in a row.

1641.name: TM - Cross Poison
1641.description:
A slashing attack with a poisonous blade
that may also leave the target poisoned.
Critical hits land more easily.

1642.name: TM - Water Gun
1642.description:
The target is blasted with a
forceful shot of water.

1643.name: TM - Hydro Pump
1643.description:
The target is blasted by a huge volume
of water launched under great pressure.

1644.name: TM - BubbleBeam
1644.description:
A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected
at the opposing team. It may also lower
their Speed stats.

1645.name: TM - Submission
1645.description:
The user grabs the target and recklessly
dives for the ground. It also hurts the
user slightly.

1646.name: TM - Mega Drain
1646.description:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

1647.name: TM - Dragon Rage
1647.description:
This attack hits the target with a shock
wave of pure rage. This attack always
inflicts 40 HP damage.

1648.name: TM - Fire Spin
1648.description:
The target becomes trapped within a
fierce vortex of fire that rages for four
to five turns.

1649.name: TM - Heavy Slam
1649.description:
The user slams into the target with its
heavy body. The more the user outweighs
the target, the greater its damage.

1650.name: TM - Electro Ball
1650.description:
The user hurls an electric orb
at the target. The faster the user is
than the target, the greater the damage.

1651.name: TM - Fissure
1651.description:
The user opens up a fissure in the ground
and drops the target in.
The target instantly faints if it hits.

1652.name: TM - Agility
1652.description:
The user relaxes and lightens its body to
move faster. It sharply boosts
the Speed stat.

1653.name: TM - Rage
1653.description:
As long as this move is in use, the power
of rage raises the Attack stat each
time the user is hit in battle.

1654.name: TM - Teleport
1654.description: When used by a Trainer, it switches the user out no matter what. Wild Pokémon may flee instantly. When used out of battle, it will warp you to the last Pokémon Center.

1655.name: TM - Stored Power
1655.description:
The user attacks the target with stored
power. The more the user's stats are
raised, the greater the damage.

1656.name: TM - Hex
1656.description:
This relentless attack does massive
damage to a target affected
by status problems.

1657.name: TM - Focus Energy
1657.description:
The user takes a deep breath and
focuses so that critical hits land
more easily.

1658.name: TM - Bide
1658.description:
The user endures attacks for two
turns, then strikes back to cause
double the damage taken.

1659.name: TM - Egg Bomb
1659.description:
A large egg is hurled at the target
with maximum force to inflict damage.

1660.name: TM - Skull Bash
1660.description:
The user tucks in its head to raise its
Defense in the first turn, then
rams the target on the next turn.

1661.name: TM - Amnesia
1661.description:
The user temporarily empties its mind to
forget its concerns.
It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

1662.name: TM - Razor Shell
1662.description:
The user cuts its target with sharp
shells. This attack may also lower the
target's Defense stat.

1663.name: TM - Heat Crash
1663.description:
The user slams its target with its flame-
covered body. The more the user outweighs
the target, the greater the damage.

1664.name: TM - Tail Slap
1664.description:
The user attacks by striking the target
with its hard tail. It hits the target two
to five times in a row.

1665.name: TM - Hurricane
1665.description:
The user attacks by wrapping its opponent
in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky.
It may also confuse the target.

1666.name: TM - Psywave
1666.description:
The target is attacked with an odd 
psychic wave.
The attack varies in intensity.

1667.name: TM - Tri Attack
1667.description:
The user strikes with a simultaneous
three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze,
or leave the target with paralysis.

1668.name: TM - Curse
1668.description: A move which functions differently depending on the type of its user. When used by a Ghost, the target loses 1/4 of their maximum HP every turn, but the user immediately loses half of theirs. For other types, it will reduce Speed while increasing Attack & Defense by 1 stage.

1669.name: TM - Reversal
1669.description:
An all-out attack that becomes more
powerful the less HP the user has.

1670.name: TM - Scary Face
1670.description:
The user frightens the target with a scary
face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

1671.name: TM - Spikes
1671.description:
The user lays a trap of spikes at the
opposing team's feet. The trap hurts
Pokémon that switch into battle.

1672.name: TM - Zap Cannon
1672.description:
The user fires an electric blast like a
cannon to inflict damage and
cause paralysis.

1673.name: TM - Detect
1673.description:
It enables the user to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used
in succession.

1674.name: TM - Charm
1674.description:
The user gazes at the target rather
charmingly, making it less wary.
The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

1675.name: TM - Megahorn
1675.description:
Using its tough and impressive horn,
the user rams into the target
with no letup.

1676.name: TM - DragonBreath
1676.description:
The user exhales a mighty gust that
inflicts damage. It may also leave the
target with paralysis.

1677.name: TM - Baton Pass
1677.description: The user switches places with a Pokémon in your party, passing along some effects. Will not pass status ailments or positive stat changes.

1678.name: TM - Encore
1678.description:
The user compels the target
to keep using only the move
it last used for three turns.

1679.name: TM - Sweet Scent
1679.description: Expels a sweet scent which lowers the foe's Evasion. It lures hordes of Pokémon when used in areas which have wild encounters, but requires more PP.

1680.name: TM - Crunch
1680.description: Crunches the foe with its sharp teeth. It may lower their Defense stat.

1681.name: TM - Future Sight
1681.description:
Two turns after this move is used,
a hunk of psychic energy
attacks the target.

1682.name: TM - Whirlpool
1682.description:
Traps foes in a violent swirling
whirlpool for four to five turns.

1683.name: TM - Beat Up
1683.description:
The user gets all party Pokémon to attack
the target. The more party Pokémon,
the greater the number of attacks.

1684.name: TM - Revenge
1684.description:
An attack move that inflicts double the
damage if the user has been hurt by the
opponent in the same turn.

1685.name: TM - Imprison
1685.description:
If the opponents know any move also known
by the user, the opponents are prevented
from using it.

1686.name: TM - Screech
1686.description:
An earsplitting screech harshly reduces
the target's Defense stat.

1687.name: TM - Blaze Kick
1687.description:
The user launches a kick that lands a
critical hit more easily.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

1688.name: TM - Weather Ball
1688.description:
An attack move that varies in power and
type depending on the weather.

1689.name: TM - Fake Tears
1689.description:
The user feigns crying to fluster
the target, harshly lowering its
Sp. Def stat.

1690.name: TM - Cosmic Power
1690.description:
The user absorbs a mystical power from
space to raise its Defense and
Sp. Def stats.

1691.name: TM - Sand Tomb
1691.description:
The user traps the target inside a harshly
raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

1692.name: TM - Muddy Water
1692.description:
The user attacks by shooting muddy water
at the opposing team.
It may also lower the targets' accuracy.

1693.name: TM - Icicle Spear
1693.description:
The user launches sharp icicles at the
target. It strikes two to five times in
a row.

1694.name: TM - Mud Shot
1694.description:
The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud
at the target.
It also reduces the target's Speed.

1695.name: TM - Magical Leaf
1695.description:
The user scatters curious leaves
that chase the target.
This attack will not miss.

1696.name: TM - Leaf Blade
1696.description:
The user handles a sharp leaf like a
sword and attacks by cutting its target.
Critical hits land more easily.

1697.name: TM - Dragon Dance
1697.description:
The user vigorously performs a mystic,
powerful dance that boosts its Attack and
Speed stats.

1698.name: TM - Rock Blast
1698.description:
The user hurls hard rocks at the target.
Two to five rocks are launched in quick
succession.

1699.name: TM - Close Combat
1699.description:
The user fights the target up close
without guarding itself. It also cuts
the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

1700.name: TM - Assurance
1700.description:
If the target has already taken some
damage in the same turn, this attack's
power is doubled.

1701.name: TM - Power Swap
1701.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
switch changes to its Attack and
Sp. Atk with the target.

1702.name: TM - Guard Swap
1702.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
switch changes to its Defense and
Sp. Def with the target.

1703.name: TM - Pay Day
1703.description: Throws coins at the foe which are recovered after the battle. The amount of coins increases with the foe's level. It's only effective once per battle.

1704.name: TM - Toxic Spikes
1704.description:
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at
the opponent's feet. They poison
opponents that switch into battle.

1705.name: TM - Flare Blitz
1705.description:
The user cloaks itself in fire and charges
at the target. The user sustains serious
damage and may leave the target burned.

1706.name: TM - Aura Sphere
1706.description:
The user looses a blast of aura power
from deep within its body at the target.
This move is certain to hit.

1707.name: TM - Counter
1707.description:
A retaliation move that counters any
physical attack, inflicting double the
damage taken.

1708.name: TM - Metronome
1708.description:
The user waggles a finger and stimulates
its brain into randomly using nearly
any move.

1709.name: TM - Mega Kick
1709.description:
The target is attacked by a kick launched
with muscle-packed power.

1710.name: TM - Mega Punch
1710.description:
The target is slugged by a punch thrown
with muscle-packed power.

1711.name: TM - Double-Edge
1711.description:
A reckless, life-risking tackle.
It also damages the user by a fairly large
amount, however.

1712.name: TM - Body Slam
1712.description:
The user drops onto the target
with its full body weight. It may also
leave the target with paralysis.

1713.name: TM - Softboiled
1713.description: Heals the user by half of its max HP.

1714.name: TM - Rollout
1714.description:
The user continually rolls into the target
over five turns. It becomes stronger
each time it hits.

1715.name: TM - DynamicPunch
1715.description:
The user punches the target with full,
concentrated power.
It confuses the target if it hits.

1716.name: TM - Mimic
1716.description:
The user copies the target's last move.
The move can be used during battle
until the Pokémon is switched out.

1717.name: TM - Fury Cutter
1717.description:
The target is slashed with scythes or
claws. Its power increases if it hits
in succession.

1718.name: TM - Seismic Toss
1718.description:
The target is thrown using the power of
gravity. It inflicts damage equal to
the user's level.

1719.name: TM - Mud-Slap
1719.description:
The user hurls mud in the target's face to
inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

1720.name: TM - Psybeam
1720.description:
The target is attacked with a peculiar ray.
It may also cause confusion.

1721.name: TM - Confuse Ray
1721.description:
The target is exposed to a sinister
ray that triggers confusion.

1722.name: TM - Poison Tail
1722.description:
The user hits the target with its tail.
It may also poison the target.
Critical hits land more easily.

1723.name: TM - Metal Claw
1723.description:
The target is raked with steel claws.
It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

1724.name: TM - Swift
1724.description:
Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing
team. This attack never misses.

1725.name: TM - Icy Wind
1725.description:
The user attacks with a gust of
chilled air. It also reduces the targets'
Speed stat.

1726.name: TM - Air Cutter
1726.description:
The user launches razor-like wind to
slash the opposing team.
Critical hits land more easily.

1727.name: TM - Night Shade
1727.description:
The user makes the target see a
frightening mirage. It inflicts damage
matching the user's level.

1728.name: TM - Foul Play
1728.description:
The user turns the target's power
against it. The higher the target's
Attack stat, the greater the damage.

1729.name: TM - Seed Bomb
1729.description:
The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled
seeds down on the target from above.

1730.name: TM - Iron Head
1730.description:
The user slams the target
with its steel-hard head.
It may also make the target flinch.

1731.name: TM - Gunk Shot
1731.description:
The user shoots filthy garbage
at the target to attack.
It may also poison the target.

1732.name: TM - Iron Defense
1732.description:
The user hardens its body's surface
like iron, sharply raising its
Defense stat.

1733.name: TM - Drill Run
1733.description:
The user crashes into its target while
rotating its body like a drill.
Critical hits land more easily.

1734.name: TM - Trick
1734.description:
The user catches the target off guard
and swaps its held item with its own.

1735.name: TM - Tailwind
1735.description:
The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind
that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon
for four turns.

1736.name: TM - Hyper Voice
1736.description:
The user lets loose a horribly echoing
shout with the power to inflict damage.

1737.name: TM - Heat Wave
1737.description:
The user attacks by exhaling hot breath
on the opposing team. It may also leave
targets with a burn.

1738.name: TM - Earth Power
1738.description:
The user makes the ground under
the target erupt with power.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

1739.name: TM - Outrage
1739.description:
The user rampages and attacks for two
to three turns.
It then becomes confused, however.

1740.name: TM - Draco Meteor
1740.description:
Comets are summoned down from the sky
onto the target. The attack's recoil
harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

1741.name: TM - Fire Punch
1741.description:
The target is punched with a fiery fist.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

1742.name: TM - Ice Punch
1742.description:
The target is punched with an icy fist.
It may also leave the target frozen.

1743.name: TM - ThunderPunch
1743.description:
The target is punched with an electrified
fist. It may also leave the target
with paralysis.

1744.name: TM - Zen Headbutt
1744.description:
The user focuses its willpower to its head
and attacks the target.
It may also make the target flinch.

1745.name: TM - Helping Hand
1745.description:
The user assists an ally by boosting
the power of its attack.

1746.name: TM - Low Kick
1746.description:
A powerful low kick that makes the target
fall over. It inflicts greater damage on
heavier targets.

1747.name: TM - Acid Spray
1747.description:
The user spits fluid that works to melt
the target. This harshly reduces
the target's Sp. Def stat.

1748.name: TM - Headbutt
1748.description:
The user sticks out its head and attacks
by charging straight into the target.
It may also make the target flinch.

1749.name: TM - Selfdestruct
1749.description:
The user attacks everything around it
by causing an explosion.
The user faints upon using this move.

1750.name: TM - Superpower
1750.description:
The user attacks the target with great
power. However, it also lowers the
user's Attack and Defense.

1751.name: TM - Charge
1751.description: The user charges up, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move. It also raises the Sp. Def of the user by 1 stage.

1752.name: TM - Haze
1752.description:
The user creates a haze that eliminates
every stat change among all the Pokémon
engaged in battle.

1753.name: TM - Spite
1753.description:
The user unleashes its grudge on the move
last used by the target by cutting 4 PP
from it.

1754.name: TM - Gravity
1754.description:
Gravity is intensified for five turns,
making moves involving flying unusable
and negating Levitate.

1755.name: TM - Knock Off
1755.description:
The user slaps down the target's
held item, preventing that item
from being used in the battle.

1756.name: TM - Bug Bite
1756.description:
The user bites the target. If the target
is holding a Berry, the user eats it and
gains its effect.

1757.name: TM - Super Fang
1757.description:
The user chomps hard on the
target with its sharp front fangs.
It cuts the target's HP to half.

1758.name: TM - Vacuum Wave
1758.description:
The user whirls its fists to send a wave
of pure vacuum at the target. This move
always goes first.

1759.name: TM - Uproar
1759.description:
The user attacks in an uproar for
three turns. Over that time,
no one can fall asleep.

1760.name: TM - Endeavor
1760.description:
An attack move that cuts down the
target's HP to equal the user's HP.

1761.name: TM - Pain Split
1761.description:
The user adds its HP to the target's HP,
then equally shares the combined HP
with the target.

1762.name: TM - FeatherDance
1762.description:
The user covers the target's body with a
mass of down that harshly lowers its
Attack stat.

1763.name: TM - Metal Sound
1763.description:
A horrible sound like scraping metal
harshly reduces the target's
Sp. Def stat.

1764.name: TM - Electroweb
1764.description:
The user captures and attacks opposing
Pokémon by using an electric net. It
reduces the targets' Speed stat.

1765.name: TM - Sing
1765.description:
A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming
voice that puts the target into a deep
slumber.

1766.name: TM - Heal Block
1766.description:
For five turns, the user prevents the
opposing team from using any moves,
Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

1767.name: TM - Sky Attack
1767.description:
A second-turn attack move where
critical hits land more easily.
It may also make the target flinch.

1768.name: TM - Comet Punch
1768.description:
The target is hit with a flurry of punches
that strike two to five times in a row.

1769.name: TM - Storm Throw
1769.description:
The user strikes the target with a fierce
blow. This attack always results in a
critical hit.

1770.name: TM - AncientPower
1770.description:
The user attacks with a prehistoric power.
It may also raise all the user's stats
at once.

1771.name: TM - Discharge
1771.description:
A flare of electricity is loosed to strike
the area around the user.
It may also cause paralysis.

1772.name: TM - Dual Chop
1772.description:
The user attacks its target by hitting
it with brutal strikes.
The target is hit twice in a row.

1773.name: TM - Fake Out
1773.description:
An attack that hits first and makes the
target flinch. It only works the first turn
the user is in battle.

1774.name: TM - Magnet Bomb
1774.description:
The user launches steel bombs that
stick to the target.
This attack will not miss.

1775.name: TM - Poison Fang
1775.description:
The user bites the target with toxic
fangs. It may also leave the target
badly poisoned.

1776.name: TM - Night Slash
1776.description:
The user slashes the target
the instant an opportunity arises.
Critical hits land more easily.

1777.name: TM - Shadow Punch
1777.description:
The user throws a punch from the shadows.
The punch lands without fail.

1778.name: TM - Petal Dance
1778.description:
The user attacks the target by scattering
petals for two to three turns.
The user then becomes confused.

1779.name: TM - Sheer Cold
1779.description:
The target is attacked with a blast of
absolute-zero cold.
The target instantly faints if it hits.

1780.name: TM - Double Hit
1780.description:
The user slams the target with a long tail,
vines, or tentacle.
The target is hit twice in a row.

1781.name: TM - Circle Throw
1781.description:
The user throws the target and drags out
another Pokémon in its party.
In the wild, the battle ends.

1782.name: TM - Ominous Wind
1782.description:
The user blasts the target with a gust of
repulsive wind. It may also raise all the
user's stats at once.

1900.name: Plume of Feathers
1900.description:
A collection of feathers from an unknown source. It may be used to alter the IVs of certain Pokémon by 1.

Consumed upon use.

1901.name: Red Envelope
1901.description:
A red envelope which contains an unknown reward.

May contain exclusive items for Lunar New Year 2026.
Use to open.

1902.name: Lucky Red Envelope
1902.description:
An extra lucky red envelope which contains an unknown reward.

May contain exclusive items for Lunar New Year 2026.
Use to open.

1903.name: Lunar New Year Mystery Box
1903.description:
A strange box which contains an unknown reward.

May contain exclusive items for Lunar New Year 2026.
Use to open.

5001.name: Master Ball
5001.description:
The best Ball with the ultimate level of
performance. It will catch any wild
Pokémon without fail.

5002.name: Ultra Ball
5002.description:
An ultra-performance Ball that
provides a higher Pokémon catch rate
than a Great Ball.

5003.name: Great Ball
5003.description:
A good, high-performance Ball that
provides a higher Pokémon catch rate
than a standard Poké Ball.

5004.name: Poké Ball
5004.description:
A device for catching wild Pokémon.
It is thrown like a ball at the target.
It is designed as a capsule system.

5005.name: Safari Ball
5005.description:
A special Poké Ball that is used only in
the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a
camouflage pattern.

5006.name: Net Ball
5006.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball which works especially well on Water and Bug-type Pokémon. It's not affected by moves or abilities which change a Pokémon's typing.

5007.name: Dive Ball
5007.description: A somewhat different ꀀPoké Ball which works especially well on Pokémon that are encountered in water.

5008.name: Nest Ball
5008.description:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that
works especially well on lower level
Pokémon in the wild.

 Starting from levels 1-16 Pokémon catch rate is 4.0x, each lvl up a Pokémon goes it losses 0.2x catch rate.

 lvl 1-16: 4.0x    lvl 17: 3.8x
 lvl 18: 3.6x        lvl 19: 3.4x
 lvl 20: 3.2x        lvl 21: 3.0x
 lvl 22: 2.8x        lvl 23: 2.6x
 lvl 24: 2.4x        lvl 25: 2.2x
 lvl 26: 2.0x        lvl 27: 1.8x
 lvl 28: 1.6x        lvl 29: 1.4x
 lvl 30: 1.2x

5009.name: Repeat Ball
5009.description: A ꀀPoké Ball which grows in strength every consecutive capture of a species of Pokémon by 0.1x until a max of 15 is caught in a row. It powers up even when using a different type of ꀀPoké Ball. Its power is reset to 1.0x if you capture something else, or if you don't capture anything for a few days.

5010.name: Timer Ball
5010.description:
A somewhat different Ball that
becomes progressively better the
more turns there are in a battle.
Each turn that passes the catch rate increases by 0.3x.

Turn 1: 1.0x        Turn 2: 1.3x
Turn 3: 1.6x        Turn 4: 1.9x
Turn 5: 2.2x        Turn 6: 2.5x
Turn 7: 2.8x        Turn 8: 3.1x
Turn 9: 3.4x        Turn 10: 3.7x
Turn 11: 4.0x

5011.name: Luxury Ball
5011.description: A luxurious ꀀPoké Ball which helps grow your friendship with a Pokémon quickly. It works well on Pokémon which evolve due to happiness.

5012.name: Premier Ball
5012.description:
A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has
been specially made to commemorate
an event of some sort.

5013.name: Dusk Ball
5013.description:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that
makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon
at night or in dark places like caves.

5014.name: Heal Ball
5014.description: A ꀀPoké Ball which restores a Pokémon's HP and eliminates any status ailment.

5015.name: Quick Ball
5015.description:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that
provides a better catch rate if it is
used at the start of a wild encounter.
It will always capture a Pokémon with a
catch rate of 154 or higher 100%

5016.name: Cherish Ball
5016.description:
A quite rare Poké Ball that has been
specially crafted to commemorate
an occasion of some sort.

5017.name: Potion (HP)
5017.description:
A spray-type medicine for wounds.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
just 20 points.

5018.name: Antidote (Status)
5018.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It lifts the effect of poison from one
Pokémon.

5019.name: Burn Heal (Status)
5019.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals a single Pokémon that is
suffering from a burn.

5020.name: Ice Heal (Status)
5020.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It defrosts a Pokémon that has been
frozen solid.

5021.name: Awakening (Status)
5021.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It awakens a Pokémon from the
clutches of sleep.

5022.name: Parlyz Heal (Status)
5022.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It eliminates paralysis from a single
Pokémon.

5023.name: Full Restore (HP)(Status)
5023.description:
A medicine that fully restores the HP
and heals any status problems of a
single Pokémon.

5024.name: Max Potion (HP)
5024.description:
A spray-type medicine for wounds.
It completely restores the HP of a
single Pokémon.

5025.name: Hyper Potion (HP)
5025.description:
A spray-type medicine for wounds.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
120 points.

5026.name: Super Potion (HP)
5026.description:
A spray-type medicine for wounds.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
60 points.

5027.name: Full Heal (Status)(HP)
5027.description:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals all the status problems of a
single Pokémon.

5028.name: Revive (Revive)
5028.description:
A medicine that revives a fainted
Pokémon. It restores half the
Pokémon's maximum HP.

5029.name: Max Revive (Revive)
5029.description:
A medicine that revives a fainted
Pokémon. It fully restores the
Pokémon's HP.

5030.name: Fresh Water (HP)
5030.description:
Water with a high mineral content.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
30 points.

5031.name: Soda Pop (HP)
5031.description:
A fizzy soda drink.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
50 points.

5032.name: Lemonade (HP)
5032.description:
A very sweet drink.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
70 points.

5033.name: Moomoo Milk (HP)
5033.description:
Milk with a very high nutrition content.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
100 points.

5034.name: EnergyPowder (HP)
5034.description:
A very bitter medicine powder.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
50 points.

5035.name: Energy Root (HP)
5035.description:
A very bitter root.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
200 points.

5036.name: Heal Powder (Status)
5036.description:
A very bitter medicine powder.
It heals all the status problems of a
single Pokémon.

5037.name: Revival Herb (Revive)
5037.description:
A very bitter herb.

It revives a Pokémon to half its max HP if they were fainted.

5038.name: Ether (PP)
5038.description:
It restores the PP of a Pokémon's
selected move by a maximum of
15 points.

5039.name: Max Ether (PP)
5039.description:
It fully restores the PP of a single
selected move that has been learned
by the target Pokémon.

5040.name: Elixir (PP)
5040.description:
It restores the PP of all the
moves learned by the targeted Pokémon
by 10 points each.

5041.name: Max Elixir (PP)
5041.description:
It fully restores the PP of all the
moves learned by the targeted
Pokémon.

5042.name: Lava Cookie (Status)
5042.description:
Lavaridge Town's local specialty.
It heals all the status problems of
one Pokémon.

5043.name: Berry Juice (HP)
5043.description:
A 20% pure juice made of Berries.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon by
just 20 points.

5044.name: Sacred Ash (Revive)
5044.description:
A bag of sparkling ash gathered after defeating Radiant Ho-Oh. When used, it revives any fainted Pokémon and restores all Pokémon in your party to full HP.

This item is consumed upon use. If used during a battle in which you white out, it will reappear after.

5045.name: HP Up (HP)
5045.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base HP of a single
Pokémon.

5046.name: Protein (ATK)
5046.description:

single Pokémon.

5047.name: Iron (DEF)
5047.description:

5048.name: Carbos (SPEED)
5048.description:

5049.name: Calcium (Sp.ATK)
5049.description:

5050.name: Rare Candy
5050.description:
A candy that is packed with energy.
It raises the level of a single Pokémon
by one.

5051.name: PP Up
5051.description:
It slightly raises the maximum PP of
a selected move that has been learned
by the target Pokémon.

5052.name: Zinc (Sp.DEF)
5052.description:

5053.name: PP Max

5057.description:

5267.name: Wise Glasses (ATK)
5267.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is
a thick pair of glasses that slightly
boosts the power of special moves by 10%.

5268.name: Expert Belt (ATK)
5268.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It boosts the power of Super Effective moves by 20%.

5269.name: Light Clay (DEF)
5269.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
If the holder uses the moves Light Screen or Reflect, their effects will be increased from 5 to 8 turns.

5270.name: Life Orb (ATK)
5270.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
Holding this item will increase the power of moves by 30% when in battle, but at the cost of 10% of the attacker's Maximum HP per-turn.

5271.name: Power Herb (ATK)
5271.description:
A single-use item to be held by a
Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of
a move that charges on the first turn.

5272.name: Toxic Orb (DEF)
5272.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons
the holder in battle.

5273.name: Flame Orb (DEF)
5273.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a
burn on the holder in battle.

5274.name: Quick Powder (SPEED+)
5274.description:
An item to be held by Ditto.
Extremely fine yet hard, this odd
powder boosts the Speed stat by double. It does not work when Ditto is transformed.

5275.name: Focus Sash (DEF)
5275.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
If it has full HP, The holder will endure a potential KO attack with 1HP.

This item is consumed upon use.

5276.name: Zoom Lens (ATK)
5276.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
If the holder moves after its target,
its accuracy will be boosted by 20%.

5277.name: Metronome (ATK)
5277.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It boosts the power of a move by 20% for each consecutive use, up to a maximum increase of 100%.

5278.name: Iron Ball (SPEED-)
5278.description:
A Pokémon held item that cuts Speed in half.
It makes Flying-type and levitating
holders susceptible to Ground moves.

5279.name: Lagging Tail (SPEED-)
5279.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is tremendously heavy and makes
the holder move slower than usual.

Forces the holder to move last in its priority bracket, regardless of its Speed

5280.name: Destiny Knot (DEF)
5280.description:
A long, thin, bright-red string to
be held by a Pokémon. If the holder
becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

5281.name: Black Sludge (DEF)
5281.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
When held by a Poison-type Pokémon in battle, 6.25% of the holder's HP is restored at the end of each turn.

When held by a Non-Poison-type Pokémon, it inflicts 12.5% of damage at the end of each turn. Pokémon with the ability Magic Guard are immune to this effect.

5282.name: Icy Rock (Snow)
5282.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of Snowy weather to 8 turns, when created by the item holder.

5283.name: Smooth Rock (Sand)
5283.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of Sandstorm weather to 8 turns, when created by the item holder.

5284.name: Heat Rock (Sun)
5284.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of Harsh Sunlight weather to 8 turns, when created by the item holder.

5285.name: Damp Rock (Rain)
5285.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of Rain weather to 8 turns, when created by the item holder.

5286.name: Grip Claw (ATK)
5286.description: When held by a Pokémon, it causes binding moves used by the holder to always continue for 7 turns.

5287.name: Choice Scarf (ATK)(SPEED)
5287.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
Holding this item will increase Speed by 50% when in battle, but only allows the use of the first move selected.

5288.name: Sticky Barb (DEF)
5288.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It inflicts the holder with 12.5% of its maximum HP each turn.

If the holder is hit with a move that makes contact, the ꈘSticky Barb (DEF) will latch onto the opponent.

Pokémon with the ability Magic Guard do not take damage from this item.

5289.name: Power Bracer (ATK)
5289.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's Attack IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5290.name: Power Belt (DEF)
5290.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's Defense IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5291.name: Power Lens (Sp.ATK)
5291.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's Sp.Atk IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5292.name: Power Band (Sp.DEF)
5292.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's Sp.Def IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5293.name: Power Anklet (SPEED)
5293.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's Speed IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5294.name: Power Weight (HP)
5294.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon when breeding.
Holding this item will guarantee the child inherits this Pokémon's HP IV.

This item is consumed upon use.

5295.name: Shed Shell (SPEED+)
5295.description:
A tough, discarded carapace to be held
by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to
switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

5296.name: Big Root (ATK)
5296.description:
A Pokémon held item that boosts the
power of HP-stealing moves to let the
holder recover more HP.

it restores 30% more HP than it otherwise would. Additionally, a Pokémon holding a Big Root regains 30% more HP from Leech Seed, Ingrain and Aqua Ring.

5297.name: Choice Specs (ATK)
5297.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
Holding this item will increase Sp.Atk by 50% when in battle, but only allows the use of the first move selected.

5298.name: Flame Plate (Fire)
5298.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Fire-type moves by 20%.

5299.name: Splash Plate (Water)
5299.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Water-type moves by 20%.

5300.name: Zap Plate (Electric)
5300.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Electric-type moves by 20%.

5301.name: Meadow Plate (Grass)
5301.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Grass-type moves by 20%.

5302.name: Icicle Plate (Ice)
5302.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Ice-type moves by 20%.

5303.name: Fist Plate (Fighting)
5303.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Fighting-type moves by 20%.

5304.name: Toxic Plate (Poison)
5304.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Poison-type moves by 20%.

5305.name: Earth Plate (Ground)
5305.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Ground-type moves by 20%.

5306.name: Sky Plate (Flying)
5306.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Flying-type moves by 20%.

5307.name: Mind Plate (Psychic)
5307.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Psychic-type moves by 20%.

5308.name: Insect Plate (Bug)
5308.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Bug-type moves by 20%.

5309.name: Stone Plate (Rock)
5309.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Rock-type moves by 20%.

5310.name: Spooky Plate (Ghost)
5310.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Ghost-type moves by 20%.

5311.name: Draco Plate (Dragon)
5311.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Dragon-type moves by 20%.

5312.name: Dread Plate (Dark)
5312.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Dark-type moves by 20%.

5313.name: Iron Plate (Steel)
5313.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Steel-type moves by 20%.

5314.name: Odd Incense (Psychic)
5314.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It increases the power of Psychic-type moves by 20%.

If held by a Mr. Mime while breeding, it may help them produce a Mime Jr. egg.

5315.name: Rock Incense (Rock)
5315.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It increases the power of Rock-type moves by 20%.

If held by a Sudowoodo while breeding, it may help them produce a Bonsly egg.

5316.name: Full Incense (SPEED-)
5316.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
it causes the Pokémon to move last when using a move of the same priority as the opponent.

If held by a Snorlax while breeding, it may help them produce a Munchlax egg.

5317.name: Wave Incense (Water)
5317.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It increases the power of Water-type moves by 20%.

If held by a Mantine while breeding, it may help them produce a Mantyke egg.

5318.name: Rose Incense (Grass)
5318.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It increases the power of Grass-type moves by 20%.

If held by a Roselia or Roserade while breeding, it may help them produce a Budew egg.

5319.name: Luck Incense
5319.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
If held by a Chansey while breeding, it may help them produce a Happiny egg.

5320.name: Pure Incense (Repel)
5320.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It slightly reduces the chance of encountering wild Pokémon by a third.

If held by a Chimecho while breeding, it may help them produce a Chingling egg.

5321.name: Protector (EVO)
5321.description:
A protective item of some sort.
It is extremely stiff and heavy.
It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

5322.name: Electirizer (EVO)
5322.description:
A box packed with a tremendous
amount of electric energy.
It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

5323.name: Magmarizer (EVO)
5323.description:
A box packed with a tremendous
amount of magma energy.
It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

5324.name: Dubious Disc (EVO)
5324.description:
A transparent device overflowing with
dubious data.
Its producer is unknown.

5325.name: Reaper Cloth (EVO)
5325.description:
A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong
spiritual energy.
It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

5326.name: Razor Claw (ATK)(EVO)
5326.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a sharply hooked claw that ups
the holder's critical-hit ratio by 1 stage.

5327.name: Razor Fang (ATK)(EVO)
5327.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It may make foes and allies flinch
when the holder inflicts damage by 10%.

5328.name: TM - Hone Claws
5328.description:
The user sharpens its claws to
boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

5329.name: TM - Dragon Claw
5329.description:
The user slashes the target with huge,
sharp claws.

5330.name: TM - Psyshock
5330.description:
The user materializes an odd
psychic wave to attack the target.
This attack does physical damage.

5331.name: TM - Calm Mind
5331.description:
The user quietly focuses its mind and
calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and
Sp. Def stats.

5332.name: TM - Roar
5332.description:
The target is scared off and replaced by
another Pokémon in its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

5333.name: TM - Toxic
5333.description:
A move that leaves the target
badly poisoned.
Its poison damage worsens every turn.

5334.name: TM - Snowscape
5334.description: A snowstorm forms on the field for 5 turns. Snow boosts the Defense stat of Ice-types by 50%.

5335.name: TM - Bulk Up
5335.description:
The user tenses its muscles to bulk up
its body, boosting both its Attack and
Defense stats.

5336.name: TM - Venoshock
5336.description:
The user drenches the target in a special
poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled
if the target is poisoned.

5337.name: TM - Hidden Power
5337.description: An attack which varies in type depending on its user. Its type may be changed with 40 Gems.

5338.name: TM - Sunny Day
5338.description:
The user intensifies the sun for
five turns, powering up
Fire-type moves.

5339.name: TM - Taunt
5339.description:
The target is taunted into a rage that
allows it to use only attack moves
for three turns.

5340.name: TM - Ice Beam
5340.description:
The target is struck with an icy-cold
beam of energy.
It may also freeze the target solid.

5341.name: TM - Blizzard
5341.description:
A howling blizzard is summoned to strike
the opposing team. It may also freeze
them solid.

5342.name: TM - Hyper Beam
5342.description:
The target is attacked with a powerful
beam. The user must rest on the next
turn to regain its energy.

5343.name: TM - Light Screen
5343.description:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to
suppress damage from special attacks
for five turns.

5344.name: TM - Protect
5344.description:
It enables the user to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in
succession.

5345.name: TM - Rain Dance
5345.description:
The user summons a heavy rain
that falls for five turns,
powering up Water-type moves.

5346.name: TM - Telekinesis
5346.description:
The user makes the target float with its
psychic power. The target is easier to
hit for three turns.

5347.name: TM - Safeguard
5347.description:
The user creates a protective field that
prevents status problems for five turns.

5348.name: TM - Frustration
5348.description:
A full-power attack that grows more
powerful the less the user likes
its Trainer.

5349.name: TM - SolarBeam
5349.description:
A two-turn attack. The user gathers
light, then blasts a bundled beam on the
second turn.

5350.name: TM - Smack Down
5350.description:
The user throws a stone or projectile to
attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will
fall to the ground when hit.

5351.name: TM - Thunderbolt
5351.description:
A strong electric blast is loosed at the
target. It may also leave the target
with paralysis.

5352.name: TM - Thunder
5352.description:
A wicked thunderbolt is dropped
on the target to inflict damage. It may
also leave the target with paralysis.

5353.name: TM - Earthquake
5353.description:
The user sets off an earthquake that
strikes those around it.

5354.name: TM - Return
5354.description:
A full-power attack that grows more
powerful the more the user likes
its Trainer.

5355.name: TM - Dig
5355.description:
The user burrows, then attacks
on the second turn.
It can also be used to exit dungeons.

5356.name: TM - Psychic
5356.description:
The target is hit by a strong telekinetic
force. It may also reduce the target's
Sp. Def stat.

5357.name: TM - Shadow Ball
5357.description:
The user hurls a shadowy blob at the
target. It may also lower the target's
Sp. Def stat.

5358.name: TM - Brick Break
5358.description:
The user attacks with a swift chop. It
can also break any barrier such as Light
Screen and Reflect.

5359.name: TM - Double Team
5359.description:
By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory
copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

5360.name: TM - Reflect
5360.description:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to
suppress damage from physical attacks
for five turns.

5361.name: TM - Sludge Wave
5361.description:
It swamps the area around the user with a
giant sludge wave.
It may also poison those hit.

5362.name: TM - Flamethrower
5362.description:
The target is scorched with an intense
blast of fire. It may also leave the target
with a burn.

5363.name: TM - Sludge Bomb
5363.description:
Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target.
It may also poison the target.

5364.name: TM - Sandstorm
5364.description:
A five-turn sandstorm is summoned
to hurt all combatants except the
Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

5365.name: TM - Fire Blast
5365.description:
The target is attacked with an intense
blast of all-consuming fire.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

5366.name: TM - Rock Tomb
5366.description:
Boulders are hurled at the target. It also
lowers the target's Speed by preventing
its movement.

5367.name: TM - Aerial Ace
5367.description:
The user confounds the target with speed,
then slashes.
The attack lands without fail.

5368.name: TM - Torment
5368.description:
The user torments and enrages the
target, making it incapable of using
the same move twice in a row.

5369.name: TM - Facade
5369.description:
An attack move that doubles its power if
the user is poisoned, burned, or
has paralysis.

5370.name: TM - Flame Charge
5370.description:
The user cloaks itself with flame and
attacks. Building up more power,
it raises the user's Speed stat.

5371.name: TM - Rest
5371.description:
The user goes to sleep for two turns.
It fully restores the user's HP and heals
any status problem.

5372.name: TM - Attract
5372.description:
If it is the opposite gender of the user,
the target becomes infatuated and less
likely to attack.

5373.name: TM - Thief
5373.description: An attack which steals the foe's held item if the user isn't already holding one. Its effects are temporary when stealing from Trainers.

5374.name: TM - Low Sweep
5374.description:
The user attacks the target's legs
swiftly, reducing the target's
Speed stat.

5375.name: TM - Round
5375.description:
The user attacks the target with a song.
Others can join in the Round and make
the attack do greater damage.

5376.name: TM - Echoed Voice
5376.description:
The user attacks the target with an
echoing voice. If this move is used
every turn, it does greater damage.

5377.name: TM - Overheat
5377.description:
The user attacks the target at full power.
The attack's recoil harshly reduces the
user's Sp. Atk stat.

5378.name: TM - Ally Switch
5378.description: The user teleports, switching places with its adjacent ally. It may fail if used consecutively.

5379.name: TM - Focus Blast
5379.description:
The user heightens its mental focus and
unleashes its power.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

5380.name: TM - Energy Ball
5380.description:
The user draws power from nature and
fires it at the target.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

5381.name: TM - False Swipe
5381.description:
A restrained attack that prevents the
target from fainting.
The target is left with at least 1 HP.

5382.name: TM - Scald
5382.description:
The user shoots boiling hot water at
its target. It may also leave the target
with a burn.

5383.name: TM - Fling
5383.description: The user flings its item at the foe, destroying it. In PvP, only consumable items are destroyed permanently. The move's power and effects vary depending on what item is thrown.

5384.name: TM - Charge Beam
5384.description:
The user attacks with an electric
charge. The user may use any remaining
electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

5385.name: TM - Sky Drop
5385.description:
The user takes the target into the sky,
then drops it during the next turn.
The target cannot attack while in the sky.

5386.name: TM - Incinerate
5386.description:
The user attacks the target with fire.
If the target is holding a Berry, the
Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

5387.name: TM - Quash
5387.description:
The user suppresses the target and
makes its move go last.

5388.name: TM - Will-O-Wisp
5388.description:
The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white
flame at the target to inflict a burn.

5389.name: TM - Acrobatics
5389.description:
The user nimbly strikes the target.
If the user is not holding an item,
this attack inflicts massive damage.

5390.name: TM - Embargo
5390.description:
It prevents the target from using its held
item. Its Trainer is also prevented from
using items on it.

5391.name: TM - Explosion
5391.description:
The user explodes to inflict damage on
those around it.
The user faints upon using this move.

5392.name: TM - Shadow Claw
5392.description:
The user slashes with a sharp claw made
from shadows.
Critical hits land more easily.

5393.name: TM - Payback
5393.description:
If the user moves after the target,
this attack's power will be doubled.

5394.name: TM - Retaliate
5394.description:
The user gets revenge for a fainted ally.
If an ally fainted in the previous turn,
this attack's damage increases.

5395.name: TM - Giga Impact
5395.description:
The user charges at the target using
every bit of its power.
The user must rest on the next turn.

5396.name: TM - Rock Polish
5396.description:
The user polishes its body to reduce drag.
It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

5397.name: TM - Flash
5397.description:
The user flashes a bright light that cuts
the target's accuracy.
It can also be used to illuminate caves.

5398.name: TM - Stone Edge
5398.description:
The user stabs the foe with
sharpened stones from below.
It has a high critical-hit ratio.

5399.name: TM - Volt Switch
5399.description:
After making its attack, the user
rushes back to switch places with
a party Pokémon in waiting.

5400.name: TM - Thunder Wave
5400.description:
A weak electric charge is launched at
the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

5401.name: TM - Gyro Ball
5401.description:
The user tackles the target with a
high-speed spin. The slower the
user, the greater the damage.

5402.name: TM - Swords Dance
5402.description:
A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting
spirit. It sharply raises the user's
Attack stat.

5403.name: TM - Struggle Bug
5403.description:
While resisting, the user attacks the
opposing Pokémon. The targets'
Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

5404.name: TM - Psych Up
5404.description:
The user hypnotizes itself into
copying any stat change made
by the target.

5405.name: TM - Bulldoze
5405.description:
The user stomps down on the ground
and attacks everything in the area. Hit
Pokémon's Speed stat is reduced.

5406.name: TM - Frost Breath
5406.description:
The user blows a cold breath on the
target. This attack always results in
a critical hit.

5407.name: TM - Rock Slide
5407.description:
Large boulders are hurled at the opposing
team to inflict damage. It may also make
the targets flinch.

5408.name: TM - X-Scissor
5408.description:
The user slashes at the target by
crossing its scythes or claws as if
they were a pair of scissors.

5409.name: TM - Dragon Tail
5409.description:
The user knocks away the target and
drags out another Pokémon in its party.
In the wild, the battle ends.

5410.name: TM - Work Up
5410.description:
The user is roused, and its Attack
and Sp. Atk stats increase.

5411.name: TM - Poison Jab
5411.description:
The target is stabbed with a tentacle or
arm steeped in poison. It may also
poison the target.

5412.name: TM - Dream Eater
5412.description:
The user eats the dreams of a sleeping
target. It absorbs half the damage
caused to heal the user's HP.

5413.name: TM - Grass Knot
5413.description:
The user snares the target with grass and
trips it. The heavier the target,
the greater the damage.

5414.name: TM - Swagger
5414.description:
The user enrages and confuses the target.
However, it also sharply raises the
target's Attack stat.

5415.name: TM - Pluck
5415.description:
The user pecks the target. If the target
is holding a Berry, the user eats it and
gains its effect.

5416.name: TM - U-turn
5416.description:
After making its attack, the user
rushes back to switch places with
a party Pokémon in waiting.

5417.name: TM - Substitute
5417.description:
The user makes a copy of itself using
some of its HP.
The copy serves as the user's decoy.

5418.name: TM - Flash Cannon
5418.description:
The user gathers all its light energy and
releases it at once. It may also lower the
target's Sp. Def stat.

5419.name: TM - Trick Room
5419.description:
The user creates a bizarre area in which
slower Pokémon get to move first for
five turns.

5420.name: HM - Cut
5420.description:
The target is cut with a scythe or a claw.
It can also be used to cut down
thin trees.

5421.name: HM - Fly
5421.description:
The user soars, then strikes its target
on the second turn. It can also be
used for flying to any familiar town.

5422.name: HM - Surf
5422.description:
It swamps the area around the user
with a giant wave.
It can also be used for crossing water.

5423.name: HM - Strength
5423.description:
The target is slugged with a punch thrown
at maximum power. It can also be used
to move heavy boulders.

5424.name: HM - Waterfall
5424.description:
The user charges at the target
and may make it flinch.
It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

5425.name: HM - Dive
5425.description:
Diving on the first turn, the user floats
up and attacks on the second turn.
It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

5428.name: Explorer Kit
5428.description:
A bag filled with convenient tools
for exploring. It provides access to
the Underground.

5429.name: Loot Sack
5429.description:
A sturdy, spacious bag that is used
to carry loot obtained in the coal
mine.

5430.name: Rule Book
5430.description:
It lists the rules for holding battles.
For linked battles, you may choose
which set of rules you wish to use.

5431.name: Poké Radar
5431.description:
A tool that can search out Pokémon
that are hiding in grass. Its battery is
recharged as you walk.

5432.name: Point Card
5432.description:
A card that lists the Battle Points
you have earned.

5433.name: Journal
5433.description:
A notebook that keeps a day-to-day
record of your adventure so far.

5434.name: Seal Case
5434.description:
A case for storing Seals that can be
applied to the Capsule cases of
Poké Balls.

5435.name: Fashion Case
5435.description:
A lovely case to store colorful Props
for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

5436.name: Seal Bag
5436.description:
A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for
decorating Poké Balls.

5437.name: Pal Pad
5437.description:
A convenient notepad that is used for
registering your friends, Friend Codes,
and keeping a record of game play.

5438.name: Works Key
5438.description:
A large key for operating the doors of
the Valley Windworks in the canyon.
It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

5439.name: Old Charm
5439.description:
An ancient good-luck charm made of
Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder
of Celestic Town.

5440.name: Galactic Key
5440.description:
A card key for disengaging security
systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it
can result in punishment, apparently.

5441.name: Red Chain
5441.description:
A mythical chain that is said to link
the legendary Pokémon that created
the Sinnoh region.

5442.name: Town Map
5442.description:
A very convenient map that can be
viewed anytime. It even shows your
present location.

5443.name: Vs. Seeker
5443.description:
A device that indicates Trainers who
want to battle. Its battery charges
while you walk.

5444.name: Coin Case
5444.description:
A case for holding coins obtained at
the Game Corner.
It holds up to 50,000 coins.

5445.name: Old Rod
5445.description:
An old and beat-up fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to fish for
wild aquatic Pokémon.

5446.name: Good Rod
5446.description:
A new, good-quality fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to fish for
wild aquatic Pokémon.

5447.name: Super Rod
5447.description:
An awesome, high-tech fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to fish for
wild aquatic Pokémon.

5448.name: Sprayduck
5448.description:
A watering can shaped like a Psyduck.
It helps promote healthy growth of
Berries planted in soft soil.

5449.name: Poffin Case
5449.description:
A case for storing Poffin cooked from
Berries.

5450.name: Bicycle
5450.description:
A folding Bicycle that enables much
faster movement than the Running
Shoes.

5451.name: Suite Key
5451.description:
A key to one of the suites at the
luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd
reason, it often disappears.

5452.name: Oak's Letter
5452.description:
A letter from Prof. Oak.
Written in it is a request for you to
go to Rt. 224.

5453.name: Lunar Wing
5453.description:
A feather that glows like the moon.
It is said to possess the power to
dispel nightmares.

5454.name: Member Card
5454.description:
A card needed for entering the inn in
Canalave City. Oddly, the last date
marked on it was 50 years ago.

5455.name: Azure Flute
5455.description:
A flute that puts out echoing sounds
that do not seem to be of this world.
It is unknown who made it.

5456.name: S.S. Ticket
5456.description:
The ticket required for sailing on the
ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a
ship on it.

5457.name: Contest Pass
5457.description:
The pass required for entering Pokémon
Contests. It has a drawing of an award
ribbon on it.

5458.name: Magma Stone (IVs)
5458.description:
A scorching hot stone which may be used to alter the IVs of certain Pokémon by 1.

Consumed upon use.

5459.name: Parcel
5459.description:
A parcel entrusted in your care.
You are supposed to deliver it to your
childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

5460.name: Coupon 1
5460.description:
A coupon to be exchanged for a
Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short).
Three coupons are needed.

5461.name: Coupon 2
5461.description:
A coupon to be exchanged for a
Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short).
Three coupons are needed.

5462.name: Coupon 3
5462.description:
A coupon to be exchanged for a
Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short).
Three coupons are needed.

5463.name: Storage Key
5463.description:

warehouse located at the edge of
Veilstone City.

5464.name: SecretPotion
5464.description:
A fantastic medicine dispensed by the
pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully
heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

5465.name: Vs. Recorder
5465.description:
An amazing device that can record a

5466.name: Gracidea (IVs)
5466.description:

5467.name: Secret Key
5467.description:
A high-tech key that has to be used at

electric signal to open a door.

5468.name: Apricorn Box
5468.description:
A handy box where you can store up to
99 Apricorns of each kind.

5469.name: Unown Report
5469.description:
A report of all the discovered kinds

5470.name: Berry Pots
5470.description:

5471.name: Dowsing MCHN

5472.name: Blue Card
5472.description:

5473.name: SlowpokeTail
5473.description:
A very tasty tail of something.

5474.name: Clear Bell
5474.description:

5475.name: Card Key
5475.description:
A card key that opens a shutter in the

5476.name: Basement Key
5476.description:

5477.name: SquirtBottle
5477.description:

5478.name: Red Scale
5478.description:

5479.name: Lost Item

5481.description:

5482.name: Silver Wing

5483.name: Rainbow Wing

5484.description:
A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr.

5485.description:
A red Apricorn.
Used to craft a ꀒLevel Ball
 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $1,250.
It assails your nostrils.

5486.name: Blue Apricorn
5486.description:
A blue Apricorn.

 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $1,000.
It smells a bit like grass.

5487.name: Yellow Apricorn
5487.description:
A yellow Apricorn.
Used to craft a ꀖMoon Ball
 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $500.
It has an invigorating scent.

5488.name: Green Apricorn
5488.description:
A green Apricorn.
Used to craft a ꀉFriend Ball
 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $500.
It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

5489.name: Pink Apricorn
5489.description:
A pink Apricorn.
Used to craft a ꀓLove Ball
 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $1,250.
It has a nice, sweet scent.

5490.name: White Apricorn
5490.description:
A white Apricorn.
Used to craft a ꀈFast Ball
 at Azalea Town with Kurt for $500.
It doesn't smell like anything.

5491.name: Black Apricorn
5491.description:
A black Apricorn
Used to craft a ꀑHeavy Ball

It has an indescribable scent.

5493.description: A ꀀPoké Ball which is excellent at capturing Pokémon who are the same level as yours.

5494.name: Lure Ball
5494.description:
A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked

5495.name: Heavy Ball
5495.description:
A Poké Ball for catching very heavy
Pokémon.

1.0x for species with < [100kg | 220.46lbs]
2.0x for species with < [200kg | 440.92lbs]
3.0x for species with < [300kg | 661.38lbs]
4.0x for species with >= [300kg | 661.38lbs]

5496.name: Love Ball
5496.description: A ꀀPoké Ball which is excellent at capturing Pokémon of the same evolution line as yours, but of the opposite gender. It doesn't help against genderless foes.

5497.name: Friend Ball
5497.description: A ꀀPoké Ball which makes a Pokémon very happy upon capture, giving them 78% happiness. These offer a catch rate of 2.5x on Pokémon which have a happiness evolution in their evolution line.

5498.name: Moon Ball
5498.description: A Poké Ball for catching any Pokémon in an evolution line that includes a Moon Stone evolution.

5499.name: Sport Ball
5499.description:
A special Poké Ball for the
Bug-Catching Contest.

5500.name: Park Ball
5500.description: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.

5501.name: Photo Album

5503.name: Tidal Bell

A very old-fashioned bell that makes a

5504.name: RageCandyBar (HP)

certain Pokémon.

5544.name: Binding Band (ATK)

5545.name: Absorb Bulb (ATK)

5546.name: Cell Battery (ATK)

6343.description:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to
suppress damage from special attacks
for five turns.

6344.name: TM - Protect
6344.description:
It enables the user to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in
succession.

6345.name: TM - Rain Dance
6345.description:
The user summons a heavy rain
that falls for five turns,
powering up Water-type moves.

6346.name: TM - Telekinesis
6346.description:
The user makes the target float with its
psychic power. The target is easier to
hit for three turns.

6347.name: TM - Safeguard
6347.description:
The user creates a protective field that
prevents status problems for five turns.

6348.name: TM - Frustration
6348.description:
A full-power attack that grows more
powerful the less the user likes
its Trainer.

6349.name: TM - SolarBeam
6349.description:
A two-turn attack. The user gathers
light, then blasts a bundled beam on the
second turn.

6350.name: TM - Smack Down
6350.description:
The user throws a stone or projectile to
attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will
fall to the ground when hit.

6351.name: TM - Thunderbolt
6351.description:
A strong electric blast is loosed at the
target. It may also leave the target
with paralysis.

6352.name: TM - Thunder
6352.description:
A wicked thunderbolt is dropped
on the target to inflict damage. It may
also leave the target with paralysis.

6353.name: TM - Earthquake
6353.description:
The user sets off an earthquake that
strikes those around it.

6354.name: TM - Return
6354.description:
A full-power attack that grows more
powerful the more the user likes
its Trainer.

6355.name: TM - Dig
6355.description:
The user burrows, then attacks
on the second turn.
It can also be used to exit dungeons.

6356.name: TM - Psychic
6356.description:
The target is hit by a strong telekinetic
force. It may also reduce the target's
Sp. Def stat.

6357.name: TM - Shadow Ball
6357.description:
The user hurls a shadowy blob at the
target. It may also lower the target's
Sp. Def stat.

6358.name: TM - Brick Break
6358.description:
The user attacks with a swift chop. It
can also break any barrier such as Light
Screen and Reflect.

6359.name: TM - Double Team
6359.description:
By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory
copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

6360.name: TM - Reflect
6360.description:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to
suppress damage from physical attacks
for five turns.

6361.name: TM - Sludge Wave
6361.description:
It swamps the area around the user with a
giant sludge wave.
It may also poison those hit.

6362.name: TM - Flamethrower
6362.description:
The target is scorched with an intense
blast of fire. It may also leave the target
with a burn.

6363.name: TM - Sludge Bomb
6363.description:
Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target.
It may also poison the target.

6364.name: TM - Sandstorm
6364.description:
A five-turn sandstorm is summoned
to hurt all combatants except the
Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

6365.name: TM - Fire Blast
6365.description:
The target is attacked with an intense
blast of all-consuming fire.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

6366.name: TM - Rock Tomb
6366.description:
Boulders are hurled at the target. It also
lowers the target's Speed by preventing
its movement.

6367.name: TM - Aerial Ace
6367.description:
The user confounds the target with speed,
then slashes.
The attack lands without fail.

6368.name: TM - Torment
6368.description:
The user torments and enrages the
target, making it incapable of using
the same move twice in a row.

6369.name: TM - Facade
6369.description:
An attack move that doubles its power if
the user is poisoned, burned, or
has paralysis.

6370.name: TM - Flame Charge
6370.description:
The user cloaks itself with flame and
attacks. Building up more power,
it raises the user's Speed stat.

6371.name: TM - Rest
6371.description:
The user goes to sleep for two turns.
It fully restores the user's HP and heals
any status problem.

6372.name: TM - Attract
6372.description:
If it is the opposite gender of the user,
the target becomes infatuated and less
likely to attack.

6373.name: TM - Thief
6373.description: An attack which steals the foe's held item if the user isn't already holding one. Its effects are temporary when stealing from Trainers.

6374.name: TM - Low Sweep
6374.description:
The user attacks the target's legs
swiftly, reducing the target's
Speed stat.

6375.name: TM - Round
6375.description:
The user attacks the target with a song.
Others can join in the Round and make
the attack do greater damage.

6376.name: TM - Echoed Voice
6376.description:
The user attacks the target with an
echoing voice. If this move is used
every turn, it does greater damage.

6377.name: TM - Overheat
6377.description:
The user attacks the target at full power.
The attack's recoil harshly reduces the
user's Sp. Atk stat.

6378.name: TM - Ally Switch
6378.description: The user teleports, switching places with its adjacent ally. It may fail if used consecutively.

6379.name: TM - Focus Blast
6379.description:
The user heightens its mental focus and
unleashes its power.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

6380.name: TM - Energy Ball
6380.description:
The user draws power from nature and
fires it at the target.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

6381.name: TM - False Swipe
6381.description:
A restrained attack that prevents the
target from fainting.
The target is left with at least 1 HP.

6382.name: TM - Scald
6382.description:
The user shoots boiling hot water at
its target. It may also leave the target
with a burn.

6383.name: TM - Fling
6383.description: The user flings its item at the foe, destroying it. In PvP, only consumable items are destroyed permanently. The move's power and effects vary depending on what item is thrown.

6384.name: TM - Charge Beam
6384.description:
The user attacks with an electric
charge. The user may use any remaining
electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

6385.name: TM - Sky Drop
6385.description:
The user takes the target into the sky,
then drops it during the next turn.
The target cannot attack while in the sky.

6386.name: TM - Incinerate
6386.description:
The user attacks the target with fire.
If the target is holding a Berry, the
Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

6387.name: TM - Quash
6387.description:
The user suppresses the target and
makes its move go last.

6388.name: TM - Will-O-Wisp
6388.description:
The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white
flame at the target to inflict a burn.

6389.name: TM - Acrobatics
6389.description:
The user nimbly strikes the target.
If the user is not holding an item,
this attack inflicts massive damage.

6390.name: TM - Embargo
6390.description:
It prevents the target from using its held
item. Its Trainer is also prevented from
using items on it.

6391.name: TM - Explosion
6391.description:
The user explodes to inflict damage on
those around it.
The user faints upon using this move.

6392.name: TM - Shadow Claw
6392.description:
The user slashes with a sharp claw made
from shadows.
Critical hits land more easily.

6393.name: TM - Payback
6393.description:
If the user moves after the target,
this attack's power will be doubled.

6394.name: TM - Retaliate
6394.description:
The user gets revenge for a fainted ally.
If an ally fainted in the previous turn,
this attack's damage increases.

6395.name: TM - Giga Impact
6395.description:
The user charges at the target using
every bit of its power.
The user must rest on the next turn.

6396.name: TM - Rock Polish
6396.description:
The user polishes its body to reduce drag.
It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

6397.name: TM - Flash
6397.description:
The user flashes a bright light that cuts
the target's accuracy.
It can also be used to illuminate caves.

6398.name: TM - Stone Edge
6398.description:
The user stabs the foe with
sharpened stones from below.
It has a high critical-hit ratio.

6399.name: TM - Volt Switch
6399.description:

a party Pokémon in waiting.

6400.name: TM - Thunder Wave
6400.description:
A weak electric charge is launched at

6401.name: TM - Gyro Ball
6401.description:

6402.name: TM - Swords Dance
6402.description:

6403.name: TM - Struggle Bug
6403.description:

6404.name: TM - Psych Up
6404.description:

6405.name: TM - Bulldoze
6405.description:

6406.name: TM - Frost Breath
6406.description:

6407.name: TM - Rock Slide
6407.description:
Large boulders are hurled at the opposing

6408.name: TM - X-Scissor
6408.description:

crossing its scythes or claws as if
they were a pair of scissors.

6409.name: TM - Dragon Tail
6409.description:

drags out another Pokémon in its party.

6410.name: TM - Work Up
6410.description:

6411.name: TM - Poison Jab
6411.description:

arm steeped in poison. It may also
poison the target.

6412.name: TM - Dream Eater
6412.description:
The user eats the dreams of a sleeping
target. It absorbs half the damage
caused to heal the user's HP.

6413.name: TM - Grass Knot
6413.description:
The user snares the target with grass and
trips it. The heavier the target,
the greater the damage.

6414.name: TM - Swagger
6414.description:

target's Attack stat.

6415.name: TM - Pluck
6415.description:
The user pecks the target. If the target
is holding a Berry, the user eats it and
gains its effect.

6416.name: TM - U-turn
6416.description:

rushes back to switch places with
a party Pokémon in waiting.

6417.name: TM - Substitute
6417.description:
The user makes a copy of itself using
some of its HP.
The copy serves as the user's decoy.

6418.name: TM - Flash Cannon
6418.description:

6419.name: TM - Trick Room
6419.description:
