7198.name: Headbutt Ocarina
7198.description:
Summons a Pokémon which will use Headbutt outside of a battle.

Cannot be used in certain instances.

This item may only be used in Johto.

7236.name: Broom Cookie
7236.description:
A tasty cookie exclusive to Halloween.
It restores HP when eaten, but causes a Sugar Rush in battle.

When fighting Pumpking, eating the cookie will clear stat drops on the allied field, stat boosts on the foe's field, and cloaks the allied field with Mist for 2 turns.

7237.name: Bat Cookie
7237.description:
A tasty cookie exclusive to Halloween.
It restores HP when eaten, but causes a Sugar Rush in battle.

When fighting Pumpking, eating the cookie will protect the allied field with Light Screen and Reflect for 3 turns.

7238.name: Pumpkin Cookie
7238.description:
A tasty cookie exclusive to Halloween.
It restores HP when eaten, but causes a Sugar Rush in battle.

When fighting Pumpking, eating the cookie will heal the allied field by 33% of their maximum HP.

7239.name: Ghost Cookie
7239.description:
A tasty cookie exclusive to Halloween.
It restores HP when eaten, but causes a Sugar Rush in battle.

When fighting Pumpking, eating the cookie will heal any status ailments of allies.

7240.name: Cat Cookie
7240.description:
A tasty cookie exclusive to Halloween.
It restores HP when eaten, but causes a Sugar Rush in battle.

When fighting Pumpking, eating the cookie will double the allied field's speed for 4 turns.

7250.name: Super HP Up (HP)
7250.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base HP of a single
Pokémon.

7251.name: Hyper HP Up (HP)
7251.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base HP of a single
Pokémon.

7252.name: Max HP Up (HP)
7252.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base HP of a single
Pokémon.

7253.name: Super Protein (ATK)
7253.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Attack stat of a
single Pokémon.

7254.name: Hyper Protein (ATK)
7254.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Attack stat of a
single Pokémon.

7255.name: Max Protein (ATK)
7255.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Attack stat of a
single Pokémon.

7256.name: Super Iron (DEF)
7256.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Defense stat of a
single Pokémon.

7257.name: Hyper Iron (DEF)
7257.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Defense stat of a
single Pokémon.

7258.name: Max Iron (DEF)
7258.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Defense stat of a
single Pokémon.

7259.name: Super Carbos (SPEED)
7259.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Speed stat of a
single Pokémon.

7260.name: Hyper Carbos (SPEED)
7260.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Speed stat of a
single Pokémon.

7261.name: Max Carbos (SPEED)
7261.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Speed stat of a
single Pokémon.

7262.name: Super Calcium (Sp.ATK)
7262.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Atk (Special
Attack) stat of a single Pokémon.

7263.name: Hyper Calcium (Sp.ATK)
7263.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Atk (Special
Attack) stat of a single Pokémon.

7264.name: Max Calcium (Sp.ATK)
7264.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Atk (Special
Attack) stat of a single Pokémon.

7265.name: Super Zinc (Sp.DEF)
7265.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Def (Special
Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

7266.name: Hyper Zinc (Sp.DEF)
7266.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Def (Special
Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

7267.name: Max Zinc (Sp.DEF)
7267.description:
A nutritious drink for Pokémon.
It raises the base Sp. Def (Special
Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

7409.name: Shiny Charm (+10%)
7409.description:
A charm which increases the chance to encounter a shiny Pokémon.

Stacks with other bonuses.
Consumed upon use.
Effects last 1 hour.
Link members receive a 5% bonus.

7410.name: Shiny Charm (+15%)
7410.description:
A charm which increases the chance to encounter a shiny Pokémon.

Stacks with other bonuses.
Consumed upon use.
Effects last 1 hour.
Link members receive a 5% bonus.

7411.name: Shiny Charm (+20%)
7411.description:
A charm which increases the chance to encounter a shiny Pokémon.

Stacks with other bonuses.
Consumed upon use.
Effects last 1 hour.
Link members receive a 5% bonus.

7570.name: Mystic Watch
7570.description:
An ancient, otherworldly-looking watch.

Use to reset the cooldown of a Summoning Orb.
Consumed upon use.

7600.name: TM - Focus Punch
7600.description:
The user focuses its mind before
launching a punch. It will fail if the user
is hit before it is used.

7601.name: TM - Water Pulse
7601.description:
The user attacks the target with
a pulsing blast of water.
It may also confuse the target.

7602.name: TM - Bullet Seed
7602.description:
The user forcefully shoots seeds at the
target. Two to five seeds are shot in
rapid succession.

7603.name: TM - Giga Drain
7603.description:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage
taken by the target.

7604.name: TM - Iron Tail
7604.description:
The target is slammed with a steel-hard
tail. It may also lower the target's
Defense stat.

7605.name: TM - Shock Wave
7605.description:
The user strikes the target with a quick
jolt of electricity.
This attack cannot be evaded.

7606.name: TM - Secret Power
7606.description:
The user attacks the target with a
secret power. Its added effects vary
depending on the user's environment.

7607.name: TM - Steel Wing
7607.description:
The target is hit with wings of steel.
It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

7608.name: TM - Skill Swap
7608.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
exchange Abilities with the target.

7609.name: TM - Snatch
7609.description:
The user steals the effects of any
healing or stat-changing move the
opponent attempts to use.

7610.name: TM - Roost
7610.description:
The user lands and rests its body.
It restores the user's HP by up to
half of its max HP.

7611.name: TM - Brine
7611.description:
If the target's HP is down to about half,
this attack will hit with double
the power.

7612.name: TM - Endure
7612.description:
The user endures any attack with at least
1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is
used in succession.

7613.name: TM - Dragon Pulse
7613.description:
The target is attacked with a shock wave
generated by the user's gaping mouth.

7614.name: TM - Drain Punch
7614.description:
An energy-draining punch. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

7615.name: TM - Silver Wind
7615.description:
The target is attacked with powdery
scales blown by wind.
It may also raise all the user's stats.

7616.name: TM - Recycle
7616.description:
The user recycles a held item that
has been used in battle so it can be
used again.

7617.name: TM - Avalanche
7617.description:
An attack move that inflicts double the
damage if the user has been hurt by the
target in the same turn.

7618.name: TM - Stealth Rock
7618.description:
The user lays a trap of levitating stones
around the opponent's team. The trap
hurts opponents that switch into battle.

7619.name: TM - Captivate
7619.description:
If it is the opposite gender of the user,
the target is charmed into harshly
lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

7620.name: TM - Dark Pulse
7620.description:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued
with dark thoughts.
It may also make the target flinch.

7621.name: TM - Sleep Talk
7621.description:
While it is asleep, the user randomly uses
one of the moves it knows.

7622.name: TM - Natural Gift
7622.description:
The user draws power to attack by using
its held Berry.
The Berry determines its type and power.

7623.name: TM - Leech Life
7623.description:
The user drains the target's blood.
The user's HP is restored by half the
damage taken by the target.

7624.name: TM - Nature Power
7624.description:
An attack that makes use of nature's
power. Its effects vary depending on the
user's environment.

7625.name: TM - Air Slash
7625.description:
The user attacks with a blade of air that
slices even the sky. It may also make the
target flinch.

7626.name: TM - Bug Buzz
7626.description:
The user vibrates its wings to generate a
damaging sound wave. It may also lower
the target's Sp. Def stat.

7627.name: TM - Power Gem
7627.description:
The user attacks with a ray of light that
sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

7628.name: TM - Razor Wind
7628.description:
A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit
opposing Pokémon on the second turn.
Critical hits land more easily.

7629.name: TM - Brave Bird
7629.description:
The user tucks in its wings and charges
from a low altitude.
The user also takes serious damage.

7630.name: TM - Whirlwind
7630.description:
The target is blown away, to be replaced
by another Pokémon in its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

7631.name: TM - Nasty Plot
7631.description:
The user stimulates its brain by thinking
bad thoughts.
It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

7632.name: TM - Thunder Fang
7632.description:
The user bites with electrified fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or
leave it with paralysis.

7633.name: TM - Ice Fang
7633.description:
The user bites with cold-infused fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or
leave it frozen.

7634.name: TM - Fire Fang
7634.description:
The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs.
It may also make the target flinch or leave
it burned.

7635.name: TM - Psycho Cut
7635.description:
The user tears at the target with blades
formed by psychic power.
Critical hits land more easily.

7636.name: TM - Horn Drill
7636.description:
The user stabs the target with a horn
that rotates like a drill.
If it hits, the target faints instantly.

7637.name: TM - Take Down
7637.description:
A reckless, full-body charge attack for
slamming into the target.
It also damages the user a little.

7638.name: TM - Leaf Storm
7638.description:
The user whips up a storm of leaves around
the target. The attack's recoil harshly
reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

7639.name: TM - Power Whip
7639.description:
The user violently whirls its vines or
tentacles to harshly lash the target.

7640.name: TM - Pin Missile
7640.description:
Sharp spikes are shot at the target
in rapid succession.
They hit two to five times in a row.

7641.name: TM - Cross Poison
7641.description:
A slashing attack with a poisonous blade
that may also leave the target poisoned.
Critical hits land more easily.

7642.name: TM - Water Gun
7642.description:
The target is blasted with a
forceful shot of water.

7643.name: TM - Hydro Pump
7643.description:
The target is blasted by a huge volume
of water launched under great pressure.

7644.name: TM - BubbleBeam
7644.description:
A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected
at the opposing team. It may also lower
their Speed stats.

7645.name: TM - Submission
7645.description:
The user grabs the target and recklessly
dives for the ground. It also hurts the
user slightly.

7646.name: TM - Mega Drain
7646.description:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

7647.name: TM - Dragon Rage
7647.description:
This attack hits the target with a shock
wave of pure rage. This attack always
inflicts 40 HP damage.

7648.name: TM - Fire Spin
7648.description:
The target becomes trapped within a
fierce vortex of fire that rages for four
to five turns.

7649.name: TM - Heavy Slam
7649.description:
The user slams into the target with its
heavy body. The more the user outweighs
the target, the greater its damage.

7650.name: TM - Electro Ball
7650.description:
The user hurls an electric orb
at the target. The faster the user is
than the target, the greater the damage.

7651.name: TM - Fissure
7651.description:
The user opens up a fissure in the ground
and drops the target in.
The target instantly faints if it hits.

7652.name: TM - Agility
7652.description:
The user relaxes and lightens its body to
move faster. It sharply boosts
the Speed stat.

7653.name: TM - Rage
7653.description:
As long as this move is in use, the power
of rage raises the Attack stat each
time the user is hit in battle.

7654.name: TM - Teleport
7654.description: When used by a Trainer, it switches the user out no matter what. Wild Pokémon may flee instantly. When used out of battle, it will warp you to the last Pokémon Center.

7655.name: TM - Stored Power
7655.description:
The user attacks the target with stored
power. The more the user's stats are
raised, the greater the damage.

7656.name: TM - Hex
7656.description:
This relentless attack does massive
damage to a target affected
by status problems.

7657.name: TM - Focus Energy
7657.description:
The user takes a deep breath and
focuses so that critical hits land
more easily.

7658.name: TM - Bide
7658.description:
The user endures attacks for two
turns, then strikes back to cause
double the damage taken.

7659.name: TM - Egg Bomb
7659.description:
A large egg is hurled at the target
with maximum force to inflict damage.

7660.name: TM - Skull Bash
7660.description:
The user tucks in its head to raise its
Defense in the first turn, then
rams the target on the next turn.

7661.name: TM - Amnesia
7661.description:
The user temporarily empties its mind to
forget its concerns.
It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

7662.name: TM - Razor Shell
7662.description:
The user cuts its target with sharp
shells. This attack may also lower the
target's Defense stat.

7663.name: TM - Heat Crash
7663.description:
The user slams its target with its flame-
covered body. The more the user outweighs
the target, the greater the damage.

7664.name: TM - Tail Slap
7664.description:
The user attacks by striking the target
with its hard tail. It hits the target two
to five times in a row.

7665.name: TM - Hurricane
7665.description:
The user attacks by wrapping its opponent
in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky.
It may also confuse the target.

7666.name: TM - Psywave
7666.description:
The target is attacked with an odd 
psychic wave.
The attack varies in intensity.

7667.name: TM - Tri Attack
7667.description:
The user strikes with a simultaneous
three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze,
or leave the target with paralysis.

7668.name: TM - Curse
7668.description: A move which functions differently depending on the type of its user. When used by a Ghost, the target loses 1/4 of their maximum HP every turn, but the user immediately loses half of theirs. For other types, it will reduce Speed while increasing Attack & Defense by 1 stage.

7669.name: TM - Reversal
7669.description:
An all-out attack that becomes more
powerful the less HP the user has.

7670.name: TM - Scary Face
7670.description:
The user frightens the target with a scary
face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

7671.name: TM - Spikes
7671.description:
The user lays a trap of spikes at the
opposing team's feet. The trap hurts
Pokémon that switch into battle.

7672.name: TM - Zap Cannon
7672.description:
The user fires an electric blast like a
cannon to inflict damage and
cause paralysis.

7673.name: TM - Detect
7673.description:
It enables the user to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used
in succession.

7674.name: TM - Charm
7674.description:
The user gazes at the target rather
charmingly, making it less wary.
The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

7675.name: TM - Megahorn
7675.description:
Using its tough and impressive horn,
the user rams into the target
with no letup.

7676.name: TM - DragonBreath
7676.description:
The user exhales a mighty gust that
inflicts damage. It may also leave the
target with paralysis.

7677.name: TM - Baton Pass
7677.description: The user switches places with a Pokémon in your party, passing along some effects. Will not pass status ailments or positive stat changes.

7678.name: TM - Encore
7678.description:
The user compels the target
to keep using only the move
it last used for three turns.

7679.name: TM - Sweet Scent
7679.description: Expels a sweet scent which lowers the foe's Evasion. It lures hordes of Pokémon when used in areas which have wild encounters, but requires more PP.

7680.name: TM - Crunch
7680.description: Crunches the foe with its sharp teeth. It may lower their Defense stat.

7681.name: TM - Future Sight
7681.description:
Two turns after this move is used,
a hunk of psychic energy
attacks the target.

7682.name: TM - Whirlpool
7682.description:
Traps foes in a violent swirling
whirlpool for four to five turns.

7683.name: TM - Beat Up
7683.description:
The user gets all party Pokémon to attack
the target. The more party Pokémon,
the greater the number of attacks.

7684.name: TM - Revenge
7684.description:
An attack move that inflicts double the
damage if the user has been hurt by the
opponent in the same turn.

7685.name: TM - Imprison
7685.description:
If the opponents know any move also known
by the user, the opponents are prevented
from using it.

7686.name: TM - Screech
7686.description:
An earsplitting screech harshly reduces
the target's Defense stat.

7687.name: TM - Blaze Kick
7687.description:
The user launches a kick that lands a
critical hit more easily.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

7688.name: TM - Weather Ball
7688.description:
An attack move that varies in power and
type depending on the weather.

7689.name: TM - Fake Tears
7689.description:
The user feigns crying to fluster
the target, harshly lowering its
Sp. Def stat.

7690.name: TM - Cosmic Power
7690.description:
The user absorbs a mystical power from
space to raise its Defense and
Sp. Def stats.

7691.name: TM - Sand Tomb
7691.description:
The user traps the target inside a harshly
raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

7692.name: TM - Muddy Water
7692.description:
The user attacks by shooting muddy water
at the opposing team.
It may also lower the targets' accuracy.

7693.name: TM - Icicle Spear
7693.description:
The user launches sharp icicles at the
target. It strikes two to five times in
a row.

7694.name: TM - Mud Shot
7694.description:
The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud
at the target.
It also reduces the target's Speed.

7695.name: TM - Magical Leaf
7695.description:
The user scatters curious leaves
that chase the target.
This attack will not miss.

7696.name: TM - Leaf Blade
7696.description:
The user handles a sharp leaf like a
sword and attacks by cutting its target.
Critical hits land more easily.

7697.name: TM - Dragon Dance
7697.description:
The user vigorously performs a mystic,
powerful dance that boosts its Attack and
Speed stats.

7698.name: TM - Rock Blast
7698.description:
The user hurls hard rocks at the target.
Two to five rocks are launched in quick
succession.

7699.name: TM - Close Combat
7699.description:
The user fights the target up close
without guarding itself. It also cuts
the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

7700.name: TM - Assurance
7700.description:
If the target has already taken some
damage in the same turn, this attack's
power is doubled.

7701.name: TM - Power Swap
7701.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
switch changes to its Attack and
Sp. Atk with the target.

7702.name: TM - Guard Swap
7702.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
switch changes to its Defense and
Sp. Def with the target.

7703.name: TM - Pay Day
7703.description: Throws coins at the foe which are recovered after the battle. The amount of coins increases with the foe's level. It's only effective once per battle.

7704.name: TM - Toxic Spikes
7704.description:
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at
the opponent's feet. They poison
opponents that switch into battle.

7705.name: TM - Flare Blitz
7705.description:
The user cloaks itself in fire and charges
at the target. The user sustains serious
damage and may leave the target burned.

7706.name: TM - Aura Sphere
7706.description:
The user looses a blast of aura power
from deep within its body at the target.
This move is certain to hit.

7707.name: TM - Counter
7707.description:
A retaliation move that counters any
physical attack, inflicting double the
damage taken.

7708.name: TM - Metronome
7708.description:
The user waggles a finger and stimulates
its brain into randomly using nearly
any move.

7709.name: TM - Mega Kick
7709.description:
The target is attacked by a kick launched
with muscle-packed power.

7710.name: TM - Mega Punch
7710.description:
The target is slugged by a punch thrown
with muscle-packed power.

7711.name: TM - Double-Edge
7711.description:
A reckless, life-risking tackle.
It also damages the user by a fairly large
amount, however.

7712.name: TM - Body Slam
7712.description:
The user drops onto the target
with its full body weight. It may also
leave the target with paralysis.

7713.name: TM - Softboiled
7713.description: Heals the user by half of its max HP.

7714.name: TM - Rollout
7714.description:
The user continually rolls into the target
over five turns. It becomes stronger
each time it hits.

7715.name: TM - DynamicPunch
7715.description:
The user punches the target with full,
concentrated power.
It confuses the target if it hits.

7716.name: TM - Mimic
7716.description:
The user copies the target's last move.
The move can be used during battle
until the Pokémon is switched out.

7717.name: TM - Fury Cutter
7717.description:
The target is slashed with scythes or
claws. Its power increases if it hits
in succession.

7718.name: TM - Seismic Toss
7718.description:
The target is thrown using the power of
gravity. It inflicts damage equal to
the user's level.

7719.name: TM - Mud-Slap
7719.description:
The user hurls mud in the target's face to
inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

7720.name: TM - Psybeam
7720.description:
The target is attacked with a peculiar ray.
It may also cause confusion.

7721.name: TM - Confuse Ray
7721.description:
The target is exposed to a sinister
ray that triggers confusion.

7722.name: TM - Poison Tail
7722.description:
The user hits the target with its tail.
It may also poison the target.
Critical hits land more easily.

7723.name: TM - Metal Claw
7723.description:
The target is raked with steel claws.
It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

7724.name: TM - Swift
7724.description:
Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing
team. This attack never misses.

7725.name: TM - Icy Wind
7725.description:
The user attacks with a gust of
chilled air. It also reduces the targets'
Speed stat.

7726.name: TM - Air Cutter
7726.description:
The user launches razor-like wind to
slash the opposing team.
Critical hits land more easily.

7727.name: TM - Night Shade
7727.description:
The user makes the target see a
frightening mirage. It inflicts damage
matching the user's level.

7728.name: TM - Foul Play
7728.description:
The user turns the target's power
against it. The higher the target's
Attack stat, the greater the damage.

7729.name: TM - Seed Bomb
7729.description:
The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled
seeds down on the target from above.

7730.name: TM - Iron Head
7730.description:
The user slams the target
with its steel-hard head.
It may also make the target flinch.

7731.name: TM - Gunk Shot
7731.description:
The user shoots filthy garbage
at the target to attack.
It may also poison the target.

7732.name: TM - Iron Defense
7732.description:
The user hardens its body's surface
like iron, sharply raising its
Defense stat.

7733.name: TM - Drill Run
7733.description:
The user crashes into its target while
rotating its body like a drill.
Critical hits land more easily.

7734.name: TM - Trick
7734.description:
The user catches the target off guard
and swaps its held item with its own.

7735.name: TM - Tailwind
7735.description:
The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind
that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon
for four turns.

7736.name: TM - Hyper Voice
7736.description:
The user lets loose a horribly echoing
shout with the power to inflict damage.

7737.name: TM - Heat Wave
7737.description:
The user attacks by exhaling hot breath
on the opposing team. It may also leave
targets with a burn.

7738.name: TM - Earth Power
7738.description:
The user makes the ground under
the target erupt with power.
It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

7739.name: TM - Outrage
7739.description:
The user rampages and attacks for two
to three turns.
It then becomes confused, however.

7740.name: TM - Draco Meteor
7740.description:
Comets are summoned down from the sky
onto the target. The attack's recoil
harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

7741.name: TM - Fire Punch
7741.description:
The target is punched with a fiery fist.
It may also leave the target with a burn.

7742.name: TM - Ice Punch
7742.description:
The target is punched with an icy fist.
It may also leave the target frozen.

7743.name: TM - ThunderPunch
7743.description:
The target is punched with an electrified
fist. It may also leave the target
with paralysis.

7744.name: TM - Zen Headbutt
7744.description:
The user focuses its willpower to its head
and attacks the target.
It may also make the target flinch.

7745.name: TM - Helping Hand
7745.description:
The user assists an ally by boosting
the power of its attack.

7746.name: TM - Low Kick
7746.description:

7748.description:

7749.name: TM - Selfdestruct
7749.description:

7750.name: TM - Superpower
7750.description:

7751.description: The user charges up, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move. It also raises the Sp. Def of the user by 1 stage.

7752.name: TM - Haze
7752.description:
The user creates a haze that eliminates

7753.name: TM - Spite
7753.description:
The user unleashes its grudge on the move

7754.name: TM - Gravity
7754.description:

7755.name: TM - Knock Off
7755.description:
The user slaps down the target's

from being used in the battle.

7756.name: TM - Bug Bite
7756.description:
The user bites the target. If the target

7757.name: TM - Super Fang
7757.description:

7758.name: TM - Vacuum Wave
7758.description:
The user whirls its fists to send a wave
of pure vacuum at the target. This move
always goes first.

7759.name: TM - Uproar
7759.description:

7760.name: TM - Sing
7760.description:

7761.name: TM - Heal Block

tiers.label: Pheno / Honey Tree
tiers.blurb: Phenomena or Honey Tree exclusives. ALWAYS PRIORITY — these spawns rotate constantly so missed opportunities pile up if you don't hunt them first.

tiers.label: Time / Location locked
tiers.blurb: Locked to a specific time of day, season, or single location. Hunt during the active window or be locked out.

tiers.label: Very Rare
tiers.blurb: Very low encounter rate with no shortcut (or the shortcut takes longer). Plan multi-hour sessions.

tiers.label: Normal Horde
tiers.blurb: Default — common horde or wild encounter. No assigned mons; everything unlisted lands here. Use the Horde Guide + PokedexHelper.com for routes.

tiers.label: Game Corner
tiers.blurb: Purchasable at the Celadon Game Corner if you're tired of hunting / waiting for swarms. Easier to coin-grind than to find in the wild. Roster: Eevee, Dratini, Porygon, Pinsir, Scyther (and their evolution lines).
